'''Scimitar Squadron''' was an elite [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rhymer/Legends|Rhymer]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was tasked with defending the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] prior to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which saw the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] destruction and individual [[TIE pilot]]s within Scimitar Squadron attempting to escape the [[Space station/Legends|station]].

==History==
[[File:Major_rhymer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Major Rhymer, the leader of Scimitar Squadron]]
Scimitar Squadron was an elite [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] were stationed in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] and tasked with destroying any ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or equipment that might land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> which contained the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the Empire's [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> At least one of the bombers was stationed on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="CCG-Scimitar2" /> During the Battle of Endor itself, individual [[TIE pilot]]s within the squadron were aboard the Death Star, and attempted to evacuate the [[Space station/Legends|station]] prior to its destruction.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Organization==
Scimitar Squadron contained TIE/sa bombers, which were typically assigned to attack secondary targets and provide cover during bombing runs. The bombers' [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting systems]] were calibrated to track fast-moving Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="CCG-Scimitar">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar Squadron TIE}}</ref>

==Members==
[[File:Scimitar2-CCGDS2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Scimitar 2, an individual bomber of the squadron which was stationed aboard the second Death Star]]
By 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="FF" /> [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rhymer/Legends|Rhymer]] led Scimitar Squadron. He led the wing during their assignment to protect the Endor shield generator, and flew the bomber [[Scimitar 1/Legends|Scimitar 1]],<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" /> which was equipped with an advanced targeting system to increase damage during [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]].<ref name="CCG-Scimitar1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar 1}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jonus/Legends|Jonus]] operated [[Scimitar 2]] in the squadron, and often flew as top cover during [[Bomb/Legends|bombing]] runs.<ref name="CCG-Jonus">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Jonus}}</ref> At some point prior to the Battle of Endor, Scimitar 2 was struck by an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], before being subsequently repaired. Scimitar 2 was stationed on the Death Star and,<ref name="CCG-Scimitar2" /> as the battlestation suffered damage during the Battle of Endor, both its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and Rhymer were among the TIE pilots who attempted to evacuate the station prior to its destruction.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Jonus and Major Rhymer first appeared among the TIE pilots attempting to evacuate the Death Star in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[2000]], the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] first named Jonus and Rhymer, alongside their squadron.<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" /><ref name="CCG-Jonus" />
